verdict.rationale: Kit documents a public V4 REST API that covers broadcasts (create, update, delete, stats), custom fields, accounts, bulk/async processing, and cursor pagination. It supports both API-key and OAuth 2.0 auth (PKCE, refresh tokens, revocation). An llms.txt and markdown docs make the reference agent-readable, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
